title: presspool
blurb: a betting market on how long dontpressit.bisks.net's current round survives before someone presses the button and graduates it: pari-mutuel play-money odds across six time buckets, a fresh round every time the last one ends, no login. house rule, right up top: betting here and then going to press the button yourself to cash in is match-fixing, and it's grounds for punishment.
